lesson: Settled: card #26 (17 Oct) won. Levadiakos 0-0 Volos, so Both Teams To Score - No paid +$9.50 (Fox Sports, voetbalwedden and Sky Sports all show 0-0). Running total is now 29W-12L-6V, +$133.06 confirmed net. Today there is no bet. 58 league games were researched and none has a named-bookmaker price that beats its break-even by about four points: the favourites are priced out (Hammarby 1.22, Panathinaikos 1.22, Molde 1.36, Dinamo 1.38, Beijing 1.43), and the mid-price games sit at the market number. The three closest were Wuhan vs Shenhua draw at 4.33 (Betway, about four points by our count, but a best-of-market straight draw bet), Beijing vs Qingdao West Coast draw at 5.11 (1xbet) and Seoul vs Gimcheon Under 2.5, whose only price was an unnamed 2.25 from an undated prediction site. Several leagues carry no usable prices on the pages that exist (Ukraine, Colombia, Uruguay, the UAE and some Norwegian and Greek games), which is a reason to pass, not a reason to guess. Reminder from card #24: a fixture list is not a postponement check. Betfred's 18 Oct page still showed Al Nassr vs Neom (moved to 20 Oct) and Al-Sadd vs Al-Duhail (marked cancelled, reason unknown), and it showed Al-Ettifaq vs Al-Ittihad one day after Ettifaq's last game. Passing a day is a result too.

avoid.intro: Every game in the window (58 of them) was researched and none cleared our bar, so there is no bet today; the three Betfred listings that are not live games are included so nobody backs them off an old fixture list. Prices are as listed by named bookmakers on comparison sites (Bet365 via kickoff.co.uk, Wincomparator, Sportytrader, Betfred, 22Bet, 17-18 Oct) and are indicative; 'unnamed' means the page did not name its bookmaker, and we do not publish a bet off an unnamed price. 'Fair' figures are our own arithmetic from the three-way prices with the margin removed, a rough guide, not a quote. Where a game says 'No odds found', we looked for a named-bookmaker price and could not find one; for the Colombian, Uruguayan, Ukrainian, Gulf and some Norwegian and Greek games the pages that exist carry no prices, so those games could not be priced.
